The fingerprinting methodology is described somewhere?

I think its naive, so just used it here, but may be documented I did not check.

b10c:

I’m not sure if that’s a very scientific way of measuring it.

b10c:

Bandwidth and especially latency depends a lot of your location and connection to the counter party. Maybe you measured from the EU where many Datacenter nodes are hosted in Hetzner, which is physically closer to the host and thus has lower latency and higher bandwidth, and many Residential nodes are in US homes (which is physically further away from you). For example, Amsterdam ↔ NewYork ping times seem to be 76ms and you are limited at the speed of light in fiber (+routing etc) there.

Yeah, It’s measured from a single vantage, I was wrong here. But the hypothesis can be tested accurately but only for the sample size at my location. So just doing it network wide was the mistake here.
